notes.title: Patch Notes: May 28, 2025
notes.notes:
Hello Isyans!
A new day brings a new patch, and with it, new patch notes!

Check out what's new below!

 
Changes - Kingdom Quest:The spawn delay for the NPC and monsters at the start of the Midnight Brigade Kingdom Quest has been reduced.The cutscene that plays when Castor (Boss Monster) appears in the Midnight Brigade Kingdom Quest has been removed.
 
Changes - Instances:To preserve the intended drop rate mechanics, we have updated both the access levels for certain instances and the corresponding monster levels. These changes are aimed at ensuring that drop rates remain consistent with their original design, and are not unintentionally reduced due to large level gaps between players and monsters.The entry level for the following instances has been updated to support the upcoming level cap raise and maintain intended drop rates:Demonic Queen Karen - From Lv 130 ~ 150 to Lv 130 ~ 145Temple of Gods - From Lv 130 ~ 150 to Lv 130 ~ 145Citadel of Chaos - From Lv 130 ~ 150 to Lv 130 ~ 145Heart of Rotting Forest - From Lv 135 ~ 150 to Lv 135 ~ 145Night Stalker's Hideout - From Lv 135 ~ 150 to Lv 135 ~ 145The Black Deep - From Lv 135 ~ 150 to Lv 135 ~ 145Ferocious Tundra - From Lv 135 ~ 150 to Lv 135 ~ 145Ferocious Tundra (Hard) - From Lv 135 ~ 150 to Lv 135 ~ 145The level of the following instance monsters has been adjusted to maintain intended drop rates.Demonic Queen Karen - From Lv 130 to Lv 136Pagel, the God of greed - From Lv 150 to Lv 136Corrupted Kalzar - from Lv 150 to Lv 140Tainted Queen Egma - From Lv 145 to Lv 140Nature the Guise of Knowledge - From Lv 145 to Lv 140Nature the Greed of Falsehood - From Lv 145 to Lv 140The Drop Rate of the following instance monsters has been increased:Corrupted KalzarTainted Queen EgmaNature the Guise of KnowledgeNature the Greed of FalsehoodThe following monster will now drop items:The Queen, Egma
 
Changes - General:Ore drop has been added to several monsters.The logout countdown has been reduced from 10 to 5 seconds.
 

We wish you a wonderful day playing Fiesta Online!

 

See you in game!

Your Fiesta Online Team

notes.title: Patch Notes - December 11, 2024
notes.notes:
Dear Isyans, 

We've got even more Christmas content coming your way, faster than a speedy snowball!

 ✨ Berny's Back, Back Again 

The Fiesta Online community managed to get the Kebings under control, but there's more happening! Berny the Elf is back, but he needs your help.  
While helping prepare the gifts for the holiday season, some mysterious force has turned the toys berserk! Well... maybe it was Berny's fault. But he didn't mean to, he swears it!

To stop the demise of Berny's career, could you take care of the larger-than-life toys over on Blizzard's Frosty Ride?  

Two new monsters are wreaking a lot of havoc in particular, namely the JingleBot 9000 and the creepy Chillcrawler. The Elven Law Force is in shambles with all the new reports.

Collect the toys' cores to help Berny with the counter-spell he needs to stop them from taking over Isya!

He'll owe you a favor if you do. He might just stick around to be there for you, for as long as you need...

 ✨ Advent Calendar – Daily Surprises Await! 

The Advent Calendar continues throughout December! Log in daily to open a special surprise from our in-game Advent Calendar.  
Don’t miss a single one—you never know what you’ll find.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6052666/b90b297f58b376c53cc525371bf4f7c49df6a65c.jpg

 Event – Christmas (Part II): 

Berny the Elf is back and needs your help this year with a spell that didn't work as planned.  
Start this Christmas adventure by talking to him in Roumen.  
By helping him, he will owe you a huge favor. Check out his reward by stopping by Berny's Secret Gift Stash in Roumen.

Monsters related to Berny's Quests will appear in the following maps:
- Blizzard's Frosty Ride  
- Beach Coast  
- Forest of Tides  
- Forest of Mist  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6052666/bc79b58502dbb18b210169a309c1970170a604e7.jpg

Have fun, and beware of the toys!  

Your Fiesta Online Team

notes.title: Christmas Patch 🎅🎄
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5965382/192cfc63ba6fc04dff58d86b1107bb244a10690f.png


Dear Isyans,
It’s the perfect season for an exciting patch, and we’ve packed it with surprises!

[hr][/hr]

Christmas Tree Event – Protect the Holiday Spirit! 🎄
The Fiesta Team has worked tirelessly to bring festive joy to the towns, but trouble is brewing! The mischievous monster Kebing has set its sights on the biggest Christmas Tree in Elderine, leaving it incomplete and dull.

Now it’s up to you! Lend a hand to decorate the tree, defend it from Kebing’s pesky attacks, and bring the holiday magic back to Elderine. Of course, your heroic efforts won’t go unnoticed - you’ll be handsomely rewarded.

And here’s a little secret: if you feel like dancing under certain Christmas trees in town, you might stumble upon an extra surprise. Time to show off those moves!

[hr][/hr]

Hit Your Fellow Player – Snowball Battles Begin! 🎄
For those of you with a streak of mischief—your moment has arrived. Snowbanks have appeared all over the towns, and they’re loaded with snowballs ready to be thrown. Whether it’s a friend or foe, let the snowball fights begin! But don’t get too confident, you might just find yourself dodging a well-aimed snowball in return.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5965382/e23f688bc41895f47c9dd580620f4aa0d2e7aeb8.jpg

[hr][/hr]

Advent Calendar – Daily Surprises Await! 🎄
This December, every day is a gift! Log in daily to open a special surprise from our in-game Advent Calendar. Don’t miss a single one—you never know what you’ll find.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5965382/dd1e23357db6da9840a1619fd0becf0d2132abce.jpg

[hr][/hr]

Special Christmas Dungeon – Snowflake Spire 🎄
For those seeking a challenge, we’ve got something truly special. Grandpa Robin is ready to guide you on a quest that leads to the Snowflake Spire. Brave the dangers, complete the quests, and claim your rewards. Are you up to the task?

[hr][/hr]

Changes: 🎄

    Xigncode has been reactivated. The goal is to detect, log, and prevent any attempts to cheat/use bots ingame.
    The user interface for mushroom house appearance page now has two pages.
    NPC dialog in Dungeons and Kingdom Quests will now use the old display style.


[hr][/hr]

Event - Halloween: 🎄

    Halloween decorations and UI elements have been removed.
    Kaida, the Halloween NPC, is back until the next server restart – take your last chance before she disappears!


[hr][/hr]

Event – Christmas (Part I): 🎄

    Christmas decorations and UI elements have been activated.
    Christmas trees are back in town! Dance under them to receive a buff.
    The Christmas dungeon “Snowflake Spire” is back! Start the quest with Grandpa Robin to gain access to that dungeon.
    The Advent Calendar rewards have been updated! Connect in-game daily from the 1st of December!
    Use the Snowbanks in towns to gather snowballs and fight against your fellow adventurers!
    Participate in the Christmas Tree Event in Elderine! Decorate the Big Christmas Tree and protect it against the Kebing attack!
    Decorating the six small Christmas trees will grant you different buffs.
    Decorating the Big tree, up to level 5, will start the Kebing attack event after a specific wait time.
    After defeating the small Kebing 100 times, the second phase of the attack will start, with four Kebing Claws walking towards the big tree.
    Defeat all four of them by hitting them with Snowballs.
    By protecting the Big Christmas tree, you will receive a buff of +50 stats for 2 hours.


[hr][/hr]

Bug fixes: 🎄

    The bonus stats of Crimson Silks (Permanent) have been removed.
    A bug where the HP/SP stones amount wouldn’t save properly upon disconnection has been fixed.


[hr][/hr]

Your Fiesta Online Team

notes.title: Patch Notes - October 23, 2024
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5965382/0183c1ae979ccd7f72e920c5b975ba7d0803cd69.png

Hello Isyans!

Find here what is going to be done during the maintenance.

Halloween event:
Explore the New Halloween Map: "Cathedral of Despair"
This year, step into the eerie new maze design of the "Cathedral of Despair"! Are you quick enough to dodge all the Steves as you navigate the maze? Rumor has it that a new creature has been spotted haunting the maze. Do you have the courage to uncover the mystery and face this new threat?  
To enter the "Cathedral of Despair," head to Elderine and find the gate near NPC Kaida.

A Special Quest from Kaida  
Kaida needs your help with a family problem! After trying to find a companion for her shy brother Victor, she adopted several barrels named "Oakula". However, things didn’t go as planned, and now these runaway barrels are scattered all over Isya! Visit Kaida in Elderine to help clean up the mess and restore order to her quirky family.

Test Your Puzzle Skills  
Nerissa has a brand-new Halloween puzzle challenge just for you! Make sure you have at least one gold on hand, and then talk to Nerissa to put your brain to the test. Who knows what spooky rewards await those who can solve her puzzles?

Beware of Egor the Slimy  
Egor the Slimy, once a weak Slime, has transformed into a powerful Slime Knight after being bitten by the vampire Nerissa. Now, he roams Free Battle Zones 1 to 4, challenging anyone who crosses his path! Defeat Egor, and he’ll drop rewards, filled with mysterious event items. Are you up for the challenge?

Collect Halloween Reward tickets!  
Gather as many Halloween Reward Tickets as you can and trade them with Kaida, who will happily exchange them for thrilling and spooky rewards! Visit Kaida's Halloween shop and see what she has in store!

Card Collection Rewards Update:  
Following the community vote on our Discord, the last addition collection rewards have been updated!
- Octopus Cap (Permanent) has been replaced with Collector's Minihouse (Permanent).
- ChumChum (Permanent) has been replaced with Aura of the Card Collector (Permanent).
- Mini Hot Chocolate (Permanent) has been replaced with Collector's Companion (Permanent).
- Teddy the Brat (Permanent) has been replaced with Card Collector's Steed (Permanent).

The new jewels from the Card Collection have also been revised:
Instead of choosing between the “Expect Collector’s Red Ring” or the “Expect Collector’s White Ring,” you will now receive the “Grand Archivist's Ring Box”, which contains two rings, “Grand Archivist's Red Ring” and “Grand Archivist's White Ring”.

The other jewels of the card collection have been updated:
- "Expert Collector's Sawtooth Earring” has been replaced with “Grand Archivist's Earring Box”, which contains the “Grand Archivist's Sawtooth Earring”.
- “Expert Collector's Mithril Necklace” has been replaced with “Grand Archivist's Necklace Box”, which contains the “Grand Archivist's Mithril Necklace”.

The reason that all the reward jewels are now in boxes is to apply random bonus stats upon those items after opening their respective boxes.  
The Grand Archivist jewels are tradable.  
The Collection Rewards for the jewels have been reset, allowing you to reacquire them through the Card Collection interface. We will not remove the old rewards from players.

Grand Archivist Set Effect:  
A new set bonus has been added to the updated jewels, providing the following buffs:
- 2 pieces - Increase Maximum HP and SP by 8%
- 3 pieces - Increase Physical and Magical Defense by 8%
- 4 pieces - Increase Physical and Magical Damage by 8%

Others
- Free Battle Zone has activated level restrictions during this event.  
- Town Decorations and Halloween UI have returned!

See you ingame!  
Your Fiesta Online team

Hello Isyans!

Find here what is going to be done during the maintenance.

Changes:

 The difficulty of the Birthday Party Crashers has been adjusted, requiring greater team coordination for success.
 The rewards for the Birthday Party Crashers have been increased from 10 to 15 coins.


Fixes:

 We've fixed an issue where the new forge could occasionally cause a disconnect when attempting to forge items.
 We've resolved an issue where certain dances, when placed on the shortcut bar, would display incorrect icons.


Information  
Thank you for participating in the recent vote. With a clear direction from the community, we've decided to update the Card Collection Rewards.

Below are the changes coming in the near future, though they are not included in today's patch:


 The Jewels from the Card Collection System will be reworked to provide better stats.
 Completing the Card Collection will no longer force you to choose between one of two rings—you will now receive both.
 Two new titles will be added to specific cards. If you already have these cards, the titles will automatically unlock.
 The Premium Items available in the Card Collection will be replaced with new, unique items for the system.


Please note that when these changes are implemented, the existing rewards will be removed from all servers. Additionally, your rewards will be reset so that you can claim them from the collection system again.

If you've enhanced your jewels from the system, the enhancement stones used will be returned. Once the new rewards are ready, we will present them to the community before they are included in a patch.

[hr][/hr]
See you in game!  
Your Fiesta Online team

notes.title: Level Up: Prepare for the New Update!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5965382/6d59aaf4e13732956771b05282eb60de000098d6.jpg

Isyan, your next adventure is just around the corner! 

Recently, Florenz, one of our esteemed council members, disappeared under mysterious circumstances, last seen in an icy, unfamiliar region. As you think about the situation, the urgency to ensure his safe return weighs heavily on your mind. Checking your map, you carefully study the route to this new and mysterious place. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5965382/b4e0859b12d4c79b54358ceb260ca8fa77306188.png

This beautiful yet cold land, seemingly created by divine power, is home to elegantly dressed residents, and new creatures lurk in its territories.  

[previewyoutube=WI8OJiA86T8;full][/previewyoutube]

But behind its calm beauty lies a dark secret. What happened to Florenz? Is this the perfect paradise, or does it hide the secret of the Reflection of Memories? 

The council advises you to not go unprepared... 

Before you can start your adventure, take time to prepare your character for this epic journey. Here’s what you should do before visiting the new city: 


 Complete all main quests: Finish your current adventures to be fully prepared. 
 Reach Level 140: Level up to be at your strongest. 
 Tailor your armor and weapons: Customize your gear to match your play style. 
 Upgrade your equipment: Enhance your armor and weapons, and protect them with upgrade stones! 
 Clean out your storage: Sell unwanted items to gather gold for new treasures. 
 Join an academy or guild: Team up with others ready to tackle the adventure together. 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/5965382/2eb73add90163e4801716dda4c64ba7679b12fed.png

Discover More on Our Social Media Channels 
 
Follow our social media channels to stay up-to-date! 
 
Click Here! 

Prepare yourselves, Isyan. The "Reflection of Memories" awaits.  
Are you ready to unveil its secrets?

Your Fiesta Online Team

Hello Isyans! 

We are happy to celebrate Fiesta Online's grand anniversary with all of you! 

The festivities are in full swing, and we have prepared an exciting patch filled with surprises and fun.  

Let's take a closer look at the details!

Get your taste buds ready for a delightful adventure! Join your fellow adventurers in the Cupcake War Kingdom Quest, where two teams (max 8vs 8) play against each other in the Cake Arena.

Thank you all for being a part of Fiesta Online's incredible journey!   

We hope you have a fantastic time celebrating with us and that this patch brings a smile to your faces!  

See you in-game, adventurers!  

Fiesta Online Team

notes.title: Rise of Elga Patch Notes - May 30, 2023
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6052666/15134c2bece7b7bf7a3b597da77e6124c79b758b.jpg

Embark on a breathtaking journey through the enchanting realm of Elga in Fiesta Online. Brace yourself for an extraordinary adventure unlike any other!  


But beware, Isyans! Survival in the depths of Elga depends on mastering oxygen management. Navigate the treacherous waters wisely to avoid the harrowing effects of oxygen deprivation. 

Immerse yourself in a world adorned with water-inspired landscapes and formidable creatures, waiting to be conquered! 

Let's start by exploring the new places: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6052666/fbd8afc16ebc0d9d3a3bc63c4f4eead70cb5d535.jpg

Step foot into this captivating new zone, your gateway to an unforgettable adventure. To access, simply pass through the gate located in Pleasance of Ordeals. 

Take note, only those intrepid adventurers who have reached level 135 and beyond can enter this wondrous realm. 

Delve into Elga's realm and discover 5 new underground maps, each brimming with secrets and challenges to test your courage and skill. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6052666/7bf4911df51e44ea6d24605d67bdf696637badfb.jpg

Elga introduces a unique system known as the 'Breathing' mechanic'. 

In this system, you'll face the thrilling perils of drowning and suffocation due to underwater pressure. To ensure your survival, you can seek refuge in air bubbles or use Oxygen Refill items to replenish your oxygen supply. 

Will you conquer the challenges that await and leave your mark on this extraordinary realm?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6052666/68fe8de93593715d1076d48bd3e0b658a63abf14.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6052666/901bc738d32e894acfa030a49122b31c5007c7d8.jpg

Enter the mystical Arbor Vitae Sanctuary, the dwelling place of the revered soul tree.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6052666/98be581eb8767a8153d1401d506841e7260cb05f.jpg

Within this sanctuary, the Arbor Vitae tree gathers and harnesses the souls of fallen Elgains, converting them into potent magical fuel to sustain Elga's existence. 

Explore the depths of this transformed sanctuary and uncover the secrets it holds. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6052666/04cce36b63b06a75cf1738dd91667e094e49f8a2.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6052666/f4eb641f8871fd0d44a7eb4fe7f817f298603373.jpg

Descend into the depths of the Grave Base, a subterranean sanctuary that houses the spirits of Egma's loyal attendants.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6052666/3d6824bf58234ee11f9cf29d828958ad85d4e86c.jpg

Delve into the first underground layer beneath the Arbor Vitae Sanctuary. Encounter lingering souls. Unearth their secrets and face formidable foes connected to Elga's story.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6052666/60fbf9f1dcb0a4a03ae56ba77c16e76f26bd3874.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6052666/ba5a129dc09ac7440ec1ed6dbf4c432722970326.jpg

Descend further into the depths of the Dusk Den, the second underground layer beneath the Grave Base. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6052666/cf861e2156d40908029f66138b36439dc96ec590.jpg

Within the Dusk Den lies a repository of potent royal souls, destined to fuel the Arbor Vitae and unleash their corrupted energy upon Elga. 

Navigate this treacherous domain, confront formidable Guardians, and unravel the unsettling connection between these powerful souls and Elga's fate. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6052666/6782db2027aeebc3a22cee4efe47f416ec9de4b6.png

○ Get ready to face a bunch of amazing new monsters across the exciting new maps: From the tenacious Guardian Bovidae and vigilant Guardian Shepherd to the elusive Arazyl and fearsome Darathyl, a host of formidable creatures will cross your path. Watch out for the mischievous Rex, the cunning Arachnid, and the crafty Fennec, among others, as they bring excitement and challenges to your journey. 

○ Introducing 55 new questlines to guide you through the captivating world of Elga and uncover the intriguing backstory behind it all. Engage in talk quests and battle formidable foes. Level up from 135 to 140 as you uncover the secrets that will shape Elga's destiny.  

○ Get ready for the highly anticipated LVL 140 gear sets in the new realm! 

Gear sets in the realm of Elga are categorized into two distinct tiers: Corrupted and Tainted. Each tier offers its own unique advantages to aid you in your journey. Corrupted gears that you can get from the chests, provide a mysterious and exciting chance at powerful equipment. On the other hand, Tainted gears are obtained directly from the formidable boss mobs lurking in the dungeons, offering a guaranteed reward for your bravery and skill in battle. Choose your path and equip yourself with the gear that best suits your strategy and playstyle. 

In addition, the Water Realm presents the new Lvl 140 bracelets. Unlike their counterparts, these bracelets possess a unique quality. Alongside their regular stats, they hold a damage effect that will make you unstoppable. Notably, they cannot be enhanced with the traditional Fragment of Bijou, but rather require the new Bright Chunk of Bijou.  

Presenting the Egma Bracelets: Bracelet of Corrupted Egma with 10% dmg and Bracelet of Tainted Egma with 20% dmg - two versions to enhance your power in combat. 

○ A new instance is also available in this realm: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6052666/12151c6c334a2921ad3a0b5139e28fbc62917fc9.jpg

Behind a sealed magical gate lies Egma's Dungeon, where Queen Egma resides in her temple.  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6052666/a02dee8a90cdc5226c52a8fbb18845a2685b9669.jpg

Face the formidable boss, Egma and witness her awe-inspiring transformation! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6052666/94475a87cf0e43a60ddff451dd9115e486c3727a.png

Are you ready for the adventure of a lifetime? Assemble your team of up to 10 brave adventurers, all at level 135 or above, and plunge into the thrilling depths of The Black Deep! Unseen challenges, formidable foes, and untold treasures await you on this extraordinary journey. Don't miss out on this epic adventure in Fiesta Online's Rise of Elga. The realm of Elga is calling... will you answer? 

Fiesta Online Team

✓ Weapons obtained from Amatheon Corrupted will become Account Bound after transfer.

That's all for this round of patch notes, folks! 

We hope these updates, fixes, and changes make your time in Isya even more enjoyable.

Stay tuned for more exciting developments and events in the future! ✨

Your Fiesta Online Team
